tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration to carry out the purposes of this chapter—

tree.heading: NSF
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to the National Science Foundation to carry out the purposes of this chapter, $20,000,000 for each of the fiscal years 2023 through 2027.

notes.text: Amendments2022—Subsec. (a). Pub. L. 117–167, § 10649(1), substituted pars. (1) to (5) for former pars. (1) to (4) which authorized appropriations for fiscal years 2009 to 2012. Subsec. (b). Pub. L. 117–167, § 10649(2), substituted “chapter, $20,000,000 for each of the fiscal years 2023 through 2027.” for “chapter—” and pars. (1) to (4) which authorized appropriations for fiscal years 2009 to 2012.
